source: MAFF Department of Agricultural Extension (នាយកដ្ឋានផ្សព្វផ្សាយកសិកម្ម) - "ដំណាំក្រូចពោធិសាត់" (Pursat Orange Cultivation Guide), 2016, 26pp
text:
The source describes a simple fertilizing routine (ការដាក់ជី) combining a compound fertilizer, NPK 15-15-15, with urea (46-0-0). Young and mature trees are fertilized roughly twice a year, with the amount increased gradually as the tree grows - the source gives an example of scaling up the application amount (from around 400-600 grams per application) as the tree matures and its canopy and root zone expand.

Fertilizer should be spread around the drip line of the canopy - not piled directly against the trunk - and watered in after application so nutrients can reach the root zone. Consistent, moderate feeding through the year supports steady vegetative growth and, later, good fruit set.
